title: MATLAB Animation
text: Create six-degrees-of-freedom multibody custom geometry block; {Vehicles} sets the vehicle to animate, {Geometries (use ’quotes’ on filenames)} sets the vehicle geometries, {Bounding box coordinates} sets the boundary coordinates, {Camera offset} sets the distance from camera aim point to camera, {Camera view angle} and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.
